700000101.text: What a romantic tradition. Now this is worth researching!

700000103.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. Have you come to the library due to your interest in Mondstadt's romantic songs as well?

700000104.text: Still, words on a page can be read any time, but the history that happens all around us will slip by in but an instant.

700000105.text: The people of Mondstadt have many special rituals during this cozy, romantic time known as the Windblume Festival.

700000106.text: What form do these traditions take, and what of the history behind them? These are both most promising research angles.

700000107.text: I'm currently writing a research report, and I believe that descriptions alone will not suffice. Could you help me take some pictures of the sights around the Windblume Festival?

700000109.text: Thanks for helping with my research. I will certainly cite you in my acknowledgments.

700000113.text: All of the following deserve to be recorded: <color=#00E1FFFF>the floral decorations in the fountain plaza</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>the Anemo Archon statue adorned with flowers in front of the Cathedral</color>, and the <color=#00E1FFFF>flower shop owner, hard at work</color>.

700000115.text: Please help me take pictures of these sights, and pass those photos to me afterward.

700000111.text: No, no, I can't leave now. I just drafted the outline of my report. If I were to leave now, my train of thought would be interrupted.

700000112.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler. Though it isn't much, I will prepare compensation for you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a picture of the floral decorations in the fountain square

700000401.text: Welcome to Floral Whisper. Do you need anything?

700000403.text: Hmm, I suppose it's true that the Windblume Festival is unique to Mondstadt. The people of Sumeru probably don't celebrate it.

700000404.text: He wants to take a photo of me and my flowers? Sure. Mr. Sayid really has a unique way of thinking. I suppose that's researchers for you, hehe.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a picture of the Anemo God statue in front of the Cathedral

700000301.text: Perhaps I should call my paper the "Windblume Festival Report"... No, no, that's far too boring...

700000601.text: Have you finished taking those pictures?

700000603.text: Oh, these are very well shot. I'm sure that they'll come in handy in my research.

700000604.text: Seeing such lovely sights reminds me of the festivals in my hometown, Sumeru...

700000606.text: Ah, I suppose you're not familiar with our traditions. Every year, we celebrate the Sabzeruz Festival to commemorate the birth of Lesser Lord Kusanali.

700000607.text: But if we want to compare the atmosphere, I'd say that there's some difference between the festivities now and the ones back home...

700000608.text: Speaking of which, I wasn't able to take part in this year's Sabzeruz Festival either. It's been so long — I wonder how things are at the Akademiya nowadays...

700000609.text: Well, I'm getting off-topic. Regardless, thank you for your help. Please accept these as payment.

700000501.text: Welcome to Floral Whisper. We're always very busy during the Windblume Festival.

700009901.text: Well, that's those pictures taken. Oh, right, let's not forget to take a picture of Flora, too!

700009904.text: Hmm, what else did we need to take photos of... Oh, right! The Anemo Archon statue in front of the Cathedral, that's been all prettied up with flowers!

700009905.text: Well, that's that. Let's get those pictures back to Sayid.
